title: Turtle eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shell -->
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="55" rx="30" ry="22" fill="#2e7d32"/>
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="52" rx="24" ry="17" fill="#4caf50"/>
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="50" rx="18" ry="12" fill="#66bb6a"/>
  <!-- shell pattern -->
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="50" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#2e7d32"/>
  <ellipse cx="33" cy="52" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#388e3c"/>
  <ellipse cx="57" cy="52" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#388e3c"/>
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="60" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#388e3c"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx="22" cy="72" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#8bc34a"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="72" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#8bc34a"/>
  <ellipse cx="25" cy="45" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#8bc34a"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="40" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#8bc34a"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="44" rx="14" ry="12" fill="#aed581"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="82" cy="40" r="3.5" fill="#1b5e20"/>
  <circle cx="83" cy="39" r="1.5" fill="#c8e6c9"/>
  <circle cx="73" cy="40" r="3.5" fill="#1b5e20"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="39" r="1.5" fill="#c8e6c9"/>
  <!-- mouth open eating -->
  <path d="M78 50 Q84 56 90 50" stroke="#558b2f" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- snack: red apple -->
  <circle cx="94" cy="50" r="6" fill="#e53935"/>
  <circle cx="92" cy="48" r="1.5" fill="#ffcdd2"/>
  <path d="M94 44 Q96 42 97 44" stroke="#795548" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M94 44 Q93 41 95 41" stroke="#43a047" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M16 55 L8 50 L12 58 Z" fill="#8bc34a"/>
  <!-- smile cheek -->
  <circle cx="86" cy="46" r="2" fill="#f48fb1" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
